verdict.rationale: Swell documents variants with unlimited options and attributes, per-variant inventory, and custom options for made-to-order items. It also documents custom fields and models, including adding fields to existing models like products, which surface in the dashboard and API. Together these cover flexible catalog modeling rather than a fixed template. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, in-depth first-party docs on configuring variant/option schemas and merchant-facing custom-field management (evidence is mostly feature-page level).

support.subject: As a merchant, I can model products with variants, options, and custom fields/metafields that fit my catalog, not a fixed template

citations.quote: Create unique product variations with unlimited options and attributes. Track inventory of each variant in real-time.
Let your customers choose custom options for personalized or made-to-order items.
Integrate business data and custom content with your catalog using custom models and fields.
Data models can alter a store's database schema, either by adding fields to existing models (like products and orders) or creating completely new ones.
Add functionality to the dashboard and backend API with custom models.
